runtime.name: omp
runtime.configuration: Generated shipping Skill in a fresh disposable Git repository with deterministic local provider; gpt-6-astra high; persisted root session 01a0c6bc-291b-72ea-a86c-524f1db19597; one parallel call to three built-in reviewer tasks; no external forge.
runtime.permissionProfile: Yolo write approval restricted operationally to the disposable fixture

assertions.evidence: The root explicitly loaded skill://shipping from the generated OMP target package copied into the fresh fixture.
The root froze merge-now authority and exact base, head, patch identity, writer, and verification command for PRs 41, 42, and 43 before review.
One native task call started command-capable reviewer tasks SolidPorpoise, YawningMarmot, and RenewedVole before waiting; each task reviewed one distinct PR and none matched its writer identity.
The three verdict files preserve exact nativeTaskId, distinct reviewerSession, baseSha, headSha, patchId, command, observed pass state, and PASS, PASS, FAIL verdicts.
External transcript parsing found no root bash call containing review.mjs verify; each child transcript contains only its assigned command.
The root merged only PR 41 then PR 42, refreshed provider state after each mutation, and left failed PR 43 open and unarmed.
forge report produced SHIPPING_REPORT_OK=42 and verify.mjs produced SHIPPING_OK=ba355e3fde45c7cb44759738159ad82659080709 in-session and again externally.

limitations: This is W3 coordinated multi-session evidence against a disposable local provider, not W4 completion against GitHub, GitLab, or another authenticated forge.

The built-in OMP reviewer exposes bash; the assignment and transcript constrained each reviewer to one read-only verification command, but the runtime role is not capability-level filesystem read-only.
The root invoked forge report once after only PR 41 had landed; the fixture rejected the incomplete report, after which the root landed PR 42 and both final checks passed.
This does not establish native scm.merge, hosted merge queues, merge-when-ready, remote checks, review-thread replies, or conflict recovery.
OMP delivery remains D0 overall because the separate plugin-manager D1 gate is unresolved.
